people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
translations.bsb: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you but is powerful among you.
